描述_EN: eight-sided, on three feet. bulb bowl. on the base, two fishes and an inscription. inside a winged dragon with lingzhi fungus sprouting from it and five bats. outside, conventional waves.
描述_ZN: 八面体，三足。 灯泡碗。 底座上，两条鱼和一个铭文。 内有一翼龙，龙身上长出灵芝菌，有五只蝙蝠。 外侧，常规波纹。
